items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was one of the collectors. And he noticed my playing, so he invited me over to his home... Mister Fukui sent me the book, How to Play Jazz Piano

ctx.x: Of course. And there was a Hit Kit … you remember Hit Kit? I don‟t know.

[Army Navy] Hit Kit [of Popular Songs] is one of the things that the servicemen … every month or maybe twice a month, I‟m not quite sure, it was American hit songs. It was for the American servicemen. And you could get them, I think they had all those, you know, “Five Minutes More,” or like “Shoo Fly Pie,” what have you [laughs], things like that. It was lead sheets, that‟s what they played. I didn‟t know any chord symbols, I‟d never seen [those] in my life. So I said, “What‟s this?” So the violin player said,…
